changes.append: [2026-10-10 15:48 UTC; accepted general refinements] Sharp fixed universal architecture independently accepted: U_k(N;q)=2N−2 for every odd N≥3 over a field k with char(k) not dividing N and q of exact order N. Fixed legal parameter/sign slots span every N×N target by varying only phase weights. The explicit (++,-+,+-,--)=(N−2,1,1,N−2) architecture uses same-sign nodes q²,…,q^(N−1), cross-sign nodes 1, beta=1 and guards −1, entirely in k. This optimizes universal target-independent slots, not target-adaptive Fourier minima; the N11 upper bound 14 remains stronger than the universal specialization 20. Separately over C, the full legal finite-node bank rank of S^−1 is N−1 but its ordinary/Zariski border rank is 1; exact attainment uses Q(q,zeta_(N−1)). This is an inverse-shift boundary example, not a Fourier rank gap. Bank counts are not scans or arithmetic work. The omitted-infinite-endpoint mechanism is classical in spirit; exact specialized priority remains unconfirmed, with no FFT runtime claim.

changes.before: Arbitrary-matrix diagonal-pencil universal factors and reciprocity now independently proved at fixed homogeneous degree.
changes.append: [2026-10-10 15:48 UTC; accepted general refinements] Independent refinement accepted: an m²×m² Laurent divided-difference determinant equals the C03 residual V(w+w^−1) exactly over arbitrary commutative rings. Tangent/parity endpoint formulas and the signed leading-coefficient product of leading/trailing principal minors are verified. Over fields, four elimination passes without row swaps decide full residual degree and compute its leading coefficient in O(m³) operations and O(m²) space. For invertible A,B, V(2) also has an O(m³) characteristic-safe field algorithm; the singular-safe dense endpoint bound is O(m⁶). Full degree and exact collision order are different tests; the two endpoints merge in characteristic 2. R15 base closure remains intact. No fast all-coefficient resultant/recovery algorithm, bit-cost improvement or historical-priority claim.
